title: Any standing session sends one agent for a docs-only edit or a small rule-text fix and merges its PR itself on green
ruling: Owner 00:50 CST Nov 15, page item 861 b, typed in chat and relayed verbatim by the consultant: any standing session sends one agent for a docs-only edit or a small rule-text fix. For rule text, one Sonnet reviewer agent runs in the same session, with no separate spawn (his 00:49 CST words). The session then merges that PR itself through the merge tool, on green. Edits that change a guard, a check or code still go to a lane. Contradiction read by triage: decision session-tiers and standing-merge-grant hold that the coordinator never merges and a batch runner runs every merge (owner 2026-11-01 21:34 CST); relayed-yes (claude-settings .claude/CLAUDE.md) covers one named PR. This ruling reverses the 2026-11-01 ruling for these two kinds of edit only. Kept as his word. Open: whether the merge tool accepts a standing session's merge call without a change is unread. Effective now, ahead of its CLAUDE.md text (consultant 00:56 CST Nov 15, relaying the owner): any standing session, triage included, may send one agent for a docs-only edit or a small rule-text fix, run one Sonnet reviewer in the same session for rule text, and merge its own PR through the merge tool on green. Owner 00:53 CST: drive this to main, tell the sessions, confirm that every claude-settings session updates as main merges (answer on step tiny-fixes-b), and say whether the other repos keep this decision versus the CLAUDE.md gap, with child-repo sessions fixing it (step child-repos-decision-claude-md-gap).
quote: owner 00:49 CST: "one reviewer before it merges thats still just another subagent within the same session tho? it doesnt need a spawn"; owner 00:50 CST: "so B"; owner 00:53 CST: "u can prob j drive this point to main and tell the sessions too and given i believe (pls confirm) that we’ve landed that all sessions claude-settings auto update as main updates with merges ... also do let me know if all the other repos i have keep this decision vs claude md gap and have child repo sessions fix it"
